Icon disclaimer

I am NOT affiliated with the brands, services, or organizations represented by the icons on this personal website. I do not speak for them. Their logos do not mean that they sponsor, endorse, approve, or operate this site.

Brand names, logos, and other marks belong to their respective owners. They are used here to identify link destinations. I do not claim ownership of third-party logos. This notice does not grant permission to reuse them or replace their owners' usage rules.

Some links are referral links and may earn a benefit, as explained on the affiliate links page. Those disclosures still apply; a referral link does not make this an official brand website.
